annotations.title: AI company brief from 10-K risk factors, 8-Ks and XBRL

description: AI company research brief from SEC filings: the latest 10-K (business, risk factors, MD&A), recent 8-Ks and XBRL financials. Returns business model, segments, competitive position, key risks each with a verbatim 10-K quote checked in code and an EDGAR link, recent developments, watch items, and a financial snapshot copied from XBRL. Lookup by ticker, name, domain or LEI. AI-generated by Anthropic Claude; companies without a 10-K get a profile and website-only brief. Price: $0.25 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged. AI-generated answer; a call with no arguments returns the stored example answer without a model call.

domain.description: Company website domain or URL, e.g. apple.com (matched to the Wikidata official website).

lei.description: 20-character Legal Entity Identifier (ISO 17442, check digits verified), e.g. HWUPKR0MPOU8FGXBT394.

name.description: Company name, 2 to 100 characters, e.g. Apple Inc. Matched against Wikidata labels, GLEIF legal names and SEC titles.

ticker.description: US stock ticker from the SEC company tickers list, e.g. AAPL or BRK.B. At least one of ticker, name, domain or lei is required.
